Bid: When We Rise - wkshps, record music, choreo, perform, sisterhood
Name: Jessie Collins
Role/Bio: Jessie Collins is the Lead Artist on the project, assembling the team, directing the creative process. She has written 40 minutes of original music inspired by the first iteration of this project after lockdown which she will arrange & record. She will then use this in the workshops with violence survivors to inspire movement & self- expression leading to seeds for the final choregraphy. She will turn these into a choreography she will direct with her dance company for the final show. Jessie collins is a choreographer, dancer & multi instrumentalist from London with a background in classical ballet & jazz dance. She heavily rooted in the London folk music scene playing with bands such as club debris & sally in the woods. She had worked with the northern ballet, globe theatre & Candoco Dance Company & has played at the south bank centre, the Theatre royal & many smaller venues around London & further afield.
